desc: Wadsworth is a rare HED meteorite that fell in Ohio in USA on 17 March 2026. A bright daytime bolide was seen streaking through the sky over Cleveland before fragmenting. With an estimated airburst energy equal to 250 tonnes of TNT , it created a sonic boom heard dozens of miles from the event.
